page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn6e-c12g1.24xlarge is an x86_64 GPU-accelerated compute instance driven by Intel Xeon 8163 processors operating at 2.5 GHz. It provisions 96 dedicated virtual CPUs across 48 physical execution cores with simultaneous multithreading enabled. The platform is paired with 736.0 GB of system memory, averaging 7.67 GB per vCPU, and integrates an acceleration cluster consisting of 8 NVIDIA Volta V100 GPUs delivering an aggregate 256 GB of dedicated VRAM. Networking throughput is anchored by a 32 Gbps baseline interface.

Storage architecture relies entirely on external volumes, as the instance includes no bundled local NVMe or SSD drives. In synthetic CPU benchmarks, the hardware displays contrasting performance traits: the single-core stress-ng score of 1104.49 registers within the bottom 25th percentile, reflecting the conservative base clock speed of the Skylake-generation architecture. Conversely, the multi-core stress-ng score reaches 70674.73, placing in the top 25th percentile due to the parallel scaling of 96 dedicated threads.

The dense co-location of eight accelerators within a single node maximizes qualitative hardware efficiency by eliminating inter-server networking bottlenecks common to multi-node clusters. While the absence of local storage necessitates network storage considerations, the substantial memory footprint and GPU density make this server suitable for distributed deep learning training, neural network model execution, matrix compute tasks, and high-performance scientific simulations.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn6e-c12g1.24xlarge is an x86_64 GPU-accelerated instance designed for massively parallel compute workloads. Driven by Intel Xeon 8163 processors clocked at 2.5 GHz, it supplies 96 dedicated vCPUs alongside 736.0 GB of system RAM. Hardware acceleration is provided by 8 integrated NVIDIA Volta V100 GPUs yielding 256 GB of total VRAM, paired with 32 Gbps of baseline network bandwidth. The instance features no bundled local storage, relying on network-attached storage solutions. Benchmark evaluation indicates a modest single-core stress-ng score of 1104.49 alongside an upper-quartile multi-core score of 70674.73, highlighting effective multi-threaded scaling. The aggregation of eight V100 GPUs minimizes inter-node communication overhead, establishing the instance as a platform for distributed deep learning training, AI inference, and scientific simulations.
